steps.text: Forza Horizon 6 needs macOS 27 and the Wine 11 engine r18, which carries Apple's D3DMetal 4. Its copy protection opens files in a way the Wine 10 engine does not handle, and it refuses D3DMetal 3 as an unsupported graphics card (FH205). D3DMetal presents itself as an AMD card by default, and the game then crashes in its AMD-only code (its FHE21 dialog), so this recipe has D3DMetal report an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 instead. The game then offers NVIDIA Reflex, and DLSS Super Resolution when Enable DLSS (MetalFX) is on in the environment's Graphics settings (Highball 0.10.22 or later): D3DMetal runs it on MetalFX. DLSS Frame Generation stays unavailable. The first start spends about three minutes at 'Optimizing for your PC'. The game asks you to sign in to Xbox once with a code at microsoft.com/link, and remembers it from then on. On a base M4 at 1080p expect about 28 fps on the High preset the game picks, 38 on Medium with FSR Balanced (Video settings), 50 on Very Low.

knownIssues.symptom: The built-in Benchmark Mode shows a black screen
knownIssues.fix: none yet, read the frame rate from Highball's HUD instead

knownIssues.symptom: 'Your graphics card is not supported (Code: FH205)' or a crash with Code FHE21 right after the splash
knownIssues.cause: the environment is not on a D3DMetal 4 engine (r18 or later), or the recipe's graphics card setting is missing
knownIssues.fix: apply this recipe and accept the engine Play offers

knownIssues.symptom: Asked to sign in to Xbox again on every start
knownIssues.cause: engines before r18 and r19 lose the saved Xbox login on macOS
knownIssues.fix: the r18 engine this recipe asks for keeps it

knownIssues.symptom: DLSS is not in the game's Video settings
knownIssues.cause: Enable DLSS (MetalFX) is off in the environment's Graphics settings, or Highball is older than 0.10.22, which left NVIDIA's DLSS loader without a signed core to load
knownIssues.fix: update Highball, turn on Enable DLSS (MetalFX), stop the environment and start the game again

lastVerified.engine: x64-crossover26.3-r18 (Wine 11 with patches 0017 to 0019, D3DMetal 4.0b2, the 2026-10-05 shim)
lastVerified.result: Steam copy (2483190), builds 25104224 and 25588841, on a Mac mini M4 with 32 GB. Intro video, title, Xbox sign-in by device code, shader step, cinematics, character select, free roam in Tokyo and three races played, one of them start to finish. Metal HUD at 1920x1080 in Tokyo: 28 fps at the High preset the game picks, 33 with FSR Balanced, 38 at Medium + FSR Balanced, 44 at Low, 50 at Very Low. In a race at Medium + FSR Balanced 39 to 48 fps. Sound and keyboard work, saves sync. Not tested: online play, a controller, any other Mac.
